name: the prototypes flexible load
description: The prototype's default fixture, verbatim: 70 MW of shift against 1 200 MWh/day is a 50 MW flat baseline, and a freezer cannot shed more power than it draws. The rule is right, so **the fixture moved** - `REFERENCE_FLEET` is 50 MW against 1 700 MWh/day, at 71 % of the cap. This vector is what stops the rule moving back instead.
